class.name: VideoQualitySettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for 3D scaling (FSR), mesh LOD, anti-aliasing, variable rate shading and occlusion culling.

method.name: add_viewport
method.description: Adds a further viewport (for example a [SubViewport] that renders the 3D world) that gets the per-viewport values at once and every later change, like the root viewport. The two global occlusion values are not per viewport. A freed viewport is dropped on its own. See also [method get_viewport_group].

method.name: get_fsr_sharpness
method.description: Returns the pending FSR sharpness. See [member VideoQualitySettings.fsr_sharpness].

method.name: get_mesh_lod_threshold
method.description: Returns the pending mesh LOD threshold. See [member VideoQualitySettings.mesh_lod_threshold].

method.name: get_msaa_2d
method.description: Returns the pending 2D MSAA mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.msaa_2d].

method.name: get_msaa_3d
method.description: Returns the pending 3D MSAA mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.msaa_3d].

method.name: get_occlusion_culling_build_quality
method.description: Returns the pending occlusion culling BVH build quality. See [member VideoQualitySettings.occlusion_culling_build_quality].

method.name: get_occlusion_rays_per_thread
method.description: Returns the pending number of occlusion rays per thread. See [member VideoQualitySettings.occlusion_rays_per_thread].

method.name: get_scaling_3d_mode
method.description: Returns the pending 3D scaling mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.scaling_3d_mode].

method.name: get_scaling_3d_scale
method.description: Returns the pending 3D render scale. See [member VideoQualitySettings.scaling_3d_scale].

method.name: get_screen_space_aa
method.description: Returns the pending screen-space anti-aliasing mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.screen_space_aa].

method.name: get_unsupported_setting_names
method.description: Returns the names of the values the current renderer, hardware or build ignores, for example to gray out their options in a settings menu. See [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported].

method.name: get_viewport_group
method.description: Returns the group [code]&"video_quality_settings"[/code]. Every [Viewport] in this group gets the per-viewport values when it enters the tree and every later change while it is in the tree, without [method add_viewport].

method.name: get_vrs_mode
method.description: Returns the pending variable rate shading mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.vrs_mode].

method.name: has_viewport
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param viewport] was added with [method add_viewport].

method.name: is_renderer_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current renderer, hardware and build use the value [param name]. Unlike [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported], it does not check that the domain has the value.

method.name: is_scaling_3d_mode_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current renderer and hardware can use the 3D scaling [param mode]. Bilinear and Nearest always work; FSR 1.0 and FSR 2.2 need the Forward+ renderer; MetalFX Spatial needs Metal, MetalFX Temporal Metal and the Forward+ renderer. Use it to hide the modes a settings menu can't offer.

method.name: is_using_debanding
method.description: Returns the pending debanding. See [member VideoQualitySettings.use_debanding].

method.name: is_using_occlusion_culling
method.description: Returns the pending occlusion culling. See [member VideoQualitySettings.use_occlusion_culling].

method.name: is_using_taa
method.description: Returns the pending temporal anti-aliasing. See [member VideoQualitySettings.use_taa].

method.name: remove_viewport
method.description: Removes a viewport added with [method add_viewport]. It keeps its current values.

method.name: set_fsr_sharpness
method.description: Sets the FSR sharpness. See [member VideoQualitySettings.fsr_sharpness].

method.name: set_mesh_lod_threshold
method.description: Sets the mesh LOD threshold. See [member VideoQualitySettings.mesh_lod_threshold].

method.name: set_msaa_2d
method.description: Sets the 2D MSAA mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.msaa_2d].

method.name: set_msaa_3d
method.description: Sets the 3D MSAA mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.msaa_3d].

method.name: set_occlusion_culling_build_quality
method.description: Sets the occlusion culling BVH build quality. See [member VideoQualitySettings.occlusion_culling_build_quality].

method.name: set_occlusion_rays_per_thread
method.description: Sets the number of occlusion rays per thread. See [member VideoQualitySettings.occlusion_rays_per_thread].

method.name: set_scaling_3d_mode
method.description: Sets the 3D scaling mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.scaling_3d_mode].

method.name: set_scaling_3d_scale
method.description: Sets the 3D render scale. See [member VideoQualitySettings.scaling_3d_scale].

method.name: set_screen_space_aa
method.description: Sets the screen-space anti-aliasing mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.screen_space_aa].

method.name: set_use_debanding
method.description: Sets the debanding. See [member VideoQualitySettings.use_debanding].

method.name: set_use_occlusion_culling
method.description: Sets the occlusion culling. See [member VideoQualitySettings.use_occlusion_culling].

method.name: set_use_taa
method.description: Sets the temporal anti-aliasing. See [member VideoQualitySettings.use_taa].

method.name: set_vrs_mode
method.description: Sets the variable rate shading mode. See [member VideoQualitySettings.vrs_mode].
